name: fabricas
description: A custom clothing store where the customer is the designer. Five garments (tee, longsleeve, hoodie, tote, cap), twelve stock fabrics, seven inks, up to eight text/mark layers placed in percent of the print area so a design re-renders on any cut. Deterministic pricing with quantity breaks, an SVG mockup renderer with zero dependencies, a public gallery anyone can remix from with attribution, and an order rail (placed - cutting - printing - sewing - ready - shipped) kept in local SQLite. Local-first: nothing here calls out.

endpoints./info: Null call - what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./health: Liveness plus the shop's books at a glance (local disk only)
endpoints./catalog: Cuts, fabric, inks, marks, type, pricing, limits - one call, with the SVG geometry clients preview from
endpoints./quote: Price breakdown for a design (POST {design,size,qty}, or GET with design= JSON / id=)
endpoints./render: SVG mockup (GET, id= or design= JSON, width=)
endpoints./save: Validate and persist a design (POST {design,author,public,remix_of}) - content-addressed short id
endpoints./gallery: Public designs, newest first - the rack anyone can remix from
endpoints./remix: A copy of a saved design ready to edit, attribution attached (id=)
endpoints./order: Place an order for a saved design; the quote freezes into it (POST {id,size,qty,author,note})
endpoints./orders: The order book, newest first (author=, status=, limit=)
endpoints./advance: Move an order one stop down the rail, or cancel (POST {id,status?})

notes.local_first: catalog, renderer, pricing and order book all live in this directory plus one SQLite file under ~/.mod/fabricas - no print-on-demand API, no external calls
notes.design_shape: layers position in percent of the garment's print area, so the same design renders correctly remixed onto any cut
notes.content_addressed: a design's id is a hash of its normalized JSON - saving the identical design twice lands on the same id
notes.order_rail: placed - cutting - printing - sewing - ready - shipped, no skips or reversals; cancel allowed until shipped; every hop timestamped in the order's log
